title: Assignment with Bitmask DP
statement:
Assign each worker one distinct job to minimize the total cost. Use dynamic programming over job masks.

Input
n, then an n×n signed cost matrix. Row i assigns costs to worker i.

Output
Print the minimum cost of a complete assignment.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 20. Costs have absolute value at most 10⁹.
